source: Use actual archived News Intelligence outputs and existing event routing, expiry, revisions and asset matching. Feed and analysis availability gate the features. Use four explicit directions and numerically preserve confidence and materiality, separately for asset and market signals.
split: Train adjustment from 2026-11-01, on common candidates with no semantic label backfill. Fold starts Nov 5, 8 and 11, and historical test starts Nov 14. Purge a full exit horizon at each fold end. Marks stop 2026-11-20 12:00 UTC.
models: Frozen shared market-only ridge from the August split provides base forecasts. Each comparator fits a separate weighted ridge adjustment to net bps, normalized penalty 0.10, equal date and setup weights. All arms share the four raw publication-age flags and two Intelligence availability flags. Compare timing only, GDELT keyword content and actual Intelligence content. Reuse the prior monotone per-side median calibration and zero-slope cash rule. The neural arm uses a market-only prior 64/32/16 entry network and a 16/8 ReLU residual head on the same short folds. Standardize residual net payoff, cap standardized inputs at eight deviations, and fit 20 fixed weighted epochs with Adam and seed 92.
execution: Strict 15 bps hurdle, fixed $100 entries, same $1000 funded allocator, exits, fees, funding, stress and risk discount. Also evaluate News Intelligence without risk discount and cash.
scope: Short retrospective overlap. Real Intelligence data starts Oct 31. Earlier bias and evaluation reuse still apply. No reconstruction of analysis before recorded availability.
